name: tabcash
description: TabCash is a local-first shared expense tab for groups who settle directly in Bitcoin Cash. It splits BCH expenses in satoshis, calculates a compact set of paybacks, and creates a wallet payment URI when a recipient has added a BCH address. The application never takes custody of funds.

scripts.package:preview: npm test && npm run build && node scripts/package-release.js --preview
scripts.package:release: npm test && npm run check:submission && npm run build && node scripts/package-release.js
